 "score_claims": "Only three official scores are stated, all as \"user-confirmed\": V9 = 4.33, V24 = 4.77, V26 = 4.83 (latest confirmed). V25, V27, V28 and the shipped V28.1 have no score. Timing on their machine: ready in about 0.7 s, decision p50 0.3 ms, p99 0.8 ms, max 2.6 ms (Python 3.13 with an optional prebuilt C helper).",
 "architecture": "One Python file with one very long per-tick decision function; the kit's Python wrapper is used unchanged. Not a formal state machine: a latched \"recovering\" flag plus additive utility scores and a fixed goal priority. Three parameter profiles exist (aggressive / survivor / adaptive); adaptive is the default: retreat below 60% HP, heal to 91%, opportunistic repair below 79%, lightning energy reserve 7, projectile-risk weight 1.35. Per tick: (1) bookkeeping: stuck timer, last damage time/bearing/attacker, damage taken in the last 1.8 s, per-enemy acceleration estimate, 45 m visited cells; (2) threat sets: enemies within 125 m (\"close\"), count within 85 m (\"danger\"), those with a clear ray from our eye (\"exposed\"); (3) recovery latch; (4) upgrade pick from a static rank table; (5) weapon-pickup preference and loot costing; (6) target choice by additive score over mechs, drones and crates; (7) fire control; (8) goal by priority: supply drop > zone urgency > recovery (stand-still repair / drone orbit / escape, optionally onto a roof) > loot > fight orbit or farm stand-off > exploration/patrol; (9) goal clamped to zone radius minus 12 m and map bounds; (10) coarse A* if no direct line, then local steering that scores 17 directions (path direction plus 16 compass directions, plus \"stand still\" when holding); (11) jump/jet and idle aim scanning. Target score highlights (adaptive): mech base 108 minus 0.65 per metre plus up to 58 for missing HP; recent attacker (last 3 s) +149 in total; enemy within 90 m aiming at us +38; HP under 220 +42; healthier enemy beyond 35 m while we have under 6 cubes -35; crates/drones get roughly +94/+55 while we have under 10 cubes and no enemy is within 40 m, and -75 if one is, so farming dominates unless someone is shooting or aiming at us. A \"two-second damage budget\" duel estimate (per-weapon damage x shots possible in 2 s x assumed hit rate: gun 0.83 under 45 m, 0.65 under 100 m, 0.42 beyond; mortar 0.48/0.28; laser 0.80; lightning 0.96; best weapon plus half the other; cube, armour and rear-armour multipliers) feeds target score, preferred range and a third-party bonus.",
 "navigation": "Offline precomputed map cache (not built at runtime; hello.map.dir is ignored): three 2 m rasters holding ground height, highest surface height (prism tops) and distance to the nearest obstacle (obstacle = surface more than 1.4 m above ground). Pathfinding runs on an 8 m lattice (134 x 91, about 12,200 nodes): a node is walkable if obstacle distance is at least 4.1 m; 8-connected without corner cutting; edge cost adds 0.1 per metre of clearance below 8 m (prefers open ground). Weighted A* (heuristic x1.12) capped at 1,800 expansions returning the best partial path; the pure-Python fallback also has a 9 ms deadline. Replan when the goal moves over 20 m, every 2 s, or after 0.6 s stuck. Routing is skipped if a low ray to the goal is clear and it is under 75 m away, or when the goal is more than 5 m above. Waypoints are popped within 3.5 m and up to three are skipped when the next one is visible. Line-of-sight/ray test: sample the segment every ~3 m against the surface-height raster with 0.25 m margin (buildings are solid columns from ground to roof; no trees, canopy, overhangs or bridges). Local steering penalties: obstacle higher than step-up + 0.55 m at 3/7/13 m ahead (65/34/15), a softer look at 24 m, zone-edge penalty for a point 12 m ahead within 12 m of the edge, small inertia bonus. No slope handling. Stuck handling: after 0.7 s stuck with energy above 32, jump then jet for up to 1.8 s; after 2.4 s reset and drop the path. While airborne it keeps jetting if the surface 9 m ahead is more than 1.5 m above it. Goals more than 3 m above and within 35 m trigger jump + jet. Ground sprint thresholds by mode: escape/zone energy above 32 (continue down to 12); loot above 55 early or 70 (continue to 32); drop above 45; fight only when an enemy is inside 27 m and energy above 52; patrol above 90. For each direction it compares projectile risk at walk and sprint speed and refuses a sprint that turns a clean dodge into a predicted hit.",
 "aiming_and_fire_control": "Iterative intercept (3 passes for gun/laser, 6 for mortar) with half a tick of latency added. Target prediction = observed velocity plus a smoothed, capped acceleration estimate applied only for the first 0.28 s; if the predicted point lies inside a structure the lead is cut to 0.12 s; vertical lead limited to 0.6 s with gravity for falling targets and clamped to ground. Aim height is 52% of mech height (scaled by cubes), 55% for drones/crates, then clamped to the part of the target cylinder that pitch limits can reach (helps at point-blank and on height differences). Alignment tolerance is geometric: 72% of target radius/height as an angle at that distance, plus one tick of turn rate. Mortar: low direct arc only, drop compensated by raising the aim point; requires range above max(14, radius + splash + 5) m, flight under 3.5 s, and six arc sample points clear of the height raster; it is the only weapon allowed to engage a mech without line of sight (within 110 m). Lightning: target within 96% of range with a clear ray and yaw inside 42% of the cone. Weapon choice: each ready weapon has a priority (gun 30; mortar 70 vs mech under 95 m; laser 56, or 85 once charging; lightning 54 if energy covers cost + reserve), plus 70% of the other weapon's priority if both aim solutions coincide, so shared-aim volleys are preferred; when lightning leads but the gun is ready and within about a third of the cone, the gun's exact aim is used. Overrides: a ready, aligned gun whose single bullet would kill gets top priority; in a close multi-enemy fight (2+ within 85 m, nearest under 42 m, HP under 82%) the gun outranks starting a fresh laser charge because charging halves speed. Laser: start charging only when it is the lead weapon and aim is already roughly on target; hold to full charge, release when aligned; release early when the partial-charge damage x0.82 already kills; keep holding up to 0.6 s past full if not aligned; +36 target stickiness while charging; cook-off bonus counted vs mortar holders; never charge within 12 m of the zone edge or outside it, nor while retreating unless pressured with the enemy beyond 28 m. Lightning keeps 7 energy in reserve (15 while retreating or in a zone emergency unless the zap kills). Reload: when empty; proactively below 72% of the magazine if there is no target, no line of sight, or during unpressured recovery; never mid-burst; works in either slot. If the top target has no firing solution, up to three next-best candidates are tried. No shooting at targets tracked through cover beyond 30 m without a mortar.",
 "survival_and_anti_squad_tactics": "Nothing is designed for the squad practice mode specifically; the logic is free-for-all oriented. Retreat latch: enter when HP is below the threshold and an enemy is within 85 m or damage was taken in the last 6 s, or unconditionally below 50%. Threshold (adaptive) is 60%, +10 points with two or more enemies within 85 m, -9 points when the lone nearby enemy has under 45% of our HP, clamped 46-76%; raised to 73% if over 20% of max HP was lost in 1.8 s. Exit at 91% HP, or at 35% once the zone radius is under 30 m; disabled when radius is 14 m or less. \"Quiet repair\": below 79% HP with no enemy within 95 m, no drone within 70 m and 2.5 s since giving or taking damage, it stops and holds fire so the regeneration timer can run. While retreating it only returns fire if \"pressured\": an exposed enemy within 35 m, damage in the last 2.5 s, an exposed enemy under 180 HP within 65 m, or an armed enemy within 80 m closing faster than 3.5 m/s and aiming at us; otherwise it holds fire completely. Retreat movement: flee 70 m opposite the unseen damage bearing or away from the nearest enemy; each steering direction scores distance gained from up to five enemies (using a 0.35 s velocity extrapolation) and +14 per enemy whose line of sight would be blocked 12 m ahead; torso stays aimed at the threat or last damage bearing (keeps front armour toward it). Stand still to regenerate only when no enemy has line of sight, nearest is over 30 m, 1.8 s since damage and 25 m inside the zone. Roof-hop escape: with energy above 55 and an enemy within 85 m, look 12/22/32 m around for a flat roof 7-32 m up that the energy budget can reach, not closer to the enemy; commit 4 s. Escape sprint hysteresis: below 24 energy stop sprinting until 55, unless an enemy is within 28 m or the zone is an emergency. In fights: orbit at an ideal range (gun 47 m; lightning about 32 m; laser 75; mortar 78; +18 with 2+ enemies; +10 below 72% HP; down to 24-36 m against weak isolated targets) with strafe direction flipping every 2.7 s; extra lateral bonus across the aim line of enemies pointing at us, tripled if they are charging a laser; with 2+ enemies, positions keeping a lane to the target (+4.5) while blocking secondary threats (+8 each blocked, -3 each seeing us); \"reload cover\": when no weapon will be ready within about 0.4 s, favour spots out of enemy sight. Projectile dodge: up to 32 projectiles within 165 m, closest approach over 0.8 s with an acceleration-lag model, hit radius = body + 3 m (+ splash for mortar). Keeps at least 20 m from any enemy.",
 "loot_weapons_upgrades": "Loot memory: cubes kept 18 s, weapon pickups 45 s after last sight, dropped on arrival within 7 m or on took/gone events. Loot cost = distance + 1.8 x height difference + detour penalty when the low ray is blocked (8 + 0.2 per metre, max 30) + 45 if on a roof with energy under 25 + contention penalty (up to 35) if an enemy is within 25 m of it and at least 7 m closer. Cubes get a large fixed bonus, 10 per neighbouring cube within 9 m (max 30), and become much less attractive past 10 cubes unless within 2 of the next upgrade threshold. Loot is skipped during a \"combat commit\" (weak target within 65 m or recent attacker within 95 m) and, when an enemy has line of sight, limited to items within 25-35 m. Weapons: slot 1 gun is never dropped; second-slot preference laser > lightning > mortar; lightning is promoted above laser when the slot is empty and an enemy is within about 48-55 m with energy above 40-55, when holding a mortar against a nearby laser user, or when 2+ enemies are within 45 m; a charging laser is never swapped. Upgrade ranking: nanites (regen) first, then gun magazine, armour (top priority from 6 cubes), plating, laser damage, servos, lightning range/efficiency, reactor, mortar reload, gun damage, jets, laser charge, gun rate, capacitor; sensors, gyros, projectile velocity, laser pierce and lightning chain at the bottom. Supply drops: highest goal priority when it lands within travel time + 3 s, is inside the zone, no enemy within 32 m, under 240 m away and still inside the interpolated future zone at max(travel, landing) + capture time; more attractive the lower our HP; stand within 58% of the ring radius; steering penalises stepping out, and it will not abandon a capture in its last 0.9 s. Drones: orbit at about 29 m, flipping direction every 3.8 s, also as self-defence during recovery when a visible drone is within 44 m (65 m if it just hit us). Crates: approach to 13 m and stand still while shooting if no enemy is within 75 m. Farming is switched off when our HP is under 60% or an enemy is within 40 m.",
 "zone_and_endgame": "Zone urgency when the current margin is under 18 m, or travel time to the next circle (at 72% walk speed) + 10 s would overrun the shrink end with next-circle margin under 10 m, or the next radius is under 30 m with margin under 6 m. The urgency goal is not the centre but the nearest point inside the next circle on our side, at next radius minus 35% (clamped 12-42 m). Every goal is clamped to current radius minus 12 m. Objective viability check: interpolate the zone circle to the estimated arrival time (80% walk speed plus waiting) and reject loot, drops and exploration points that would be outside radius minus 5 m. In a zone emergency (margin under 12 m or outside) it sprints and will not charge the laser; non-mech targets are ignored under urgency when HP is below 78%. Final circles: once radius is under 18 m it drives to the exact centre with proportional velocity control with damping and holds when within 0.18 m and nearly stopped; healing retreat is cut short once radius is under 30 m. With 5 or fewer alive and 2+ enemies near, the fight range grows by 8 m and steering drifts away from secondary threats. Idle behaviour: with under 10 cubes and no enemy within 85 m it explores points 65/125 m away in 16 directions scored by time since that 45 m cell was visited (saturating at 90 s), openness and direct visibility; otherwise it circles at 78% of the next radius (max 220 m), changing bearing every 14 s. Idle aim sweeps about +/-106 degrees around the heading and snaps to near weapon/boost sounds or the last damage bearing.",

 "novel_ideas": [
  "Shared-aim weapon selection: pick the lead weapon by its own priority plus 70% of the other weapon's priority when both firing solutions fall within each other's tolerance; let lightning ride on the gun's exact aim when the gun solution is inside about a third of the cone.",
  "Lethal-shot overrides: a ready aligned gun wins when one bullet kills; a charging laser is released early as soon as partial-charge damage (with an 0.82 safety factor) is lethal.",
  "Do not start a laser charge in a close multi-enemy fight (halved speed); do not switch targets mid-charge; never charge near or outside the zone edge.",
  "Reload cover: when no weapon will be ready for roughly 0.4 s, bias movement toward spots that block enemy line of sight, then come back out.",
  "Fully cease fire during unpressured retreat and 'quiet repair' so the 5 s regeneration clock is not reset by our own shots; only return fire under an explicit pressure test (close, just hit, weak enemy, or armed pursuer closing and aiming).",
  "Retreat threshold as a function of enemy count, relative HP and damage burst (20% of max HP in 1.8 s), with a heal-to target for hysteresis.",
  "Sprint energy hysteresis while fleeing (stop at 24, resume at 55) so energy is not dribbled away in short bursts.",
  "Per-direction walk-versus-sprint choice from projectile risk evaluated at both speeds with an acceleration-lag model; mortar risk radius includes splash.",
  "Lead truncation when the predicted target point is inside a building; bounded acceleration term only for the first ~0.3 s.",
  "Clamp the aim point to the part of the target cylinder reachable within pitch limits rather than rejecting close or elevated targets.",
  "Energy-budgeted roof hop to break ground pursuit: flat roof 7-32 m up within 32 m, affordable rise computed from energy, jet drain and climb speed, 4 s commitment.",
  "Supply drop feasibility = max(travel time, time to landing) + capture time checked against the interpolated shrinking zone; lock in a capture during its last 0.9 s; penalise steering out of the ring.",
  "Loot pricing with detour, height, low-energy-roof and contention penalties plus cluster bonus; short-term loot memory (18 s cubes, 45 s weapons).",
  "Zone goal is the nearest point just inside the next circle on our side, not the centre; final-circle proportional velocity control with damping to settle at the centre.",
  "Coverage-based exploration (45 m cells, novelty saturating at 90 s) while under 10 cubes.",
  "Lateral-movement bonus measured against the aim direction of enemies currently pointing at us, tripled for a charging laser.",
  "Offline three-layer map cache (ground, top surface, obstacle distance) with an optional native helper and an equivalence-tested pure fallback."

 "apparent_weaknesses": [
  "No simulator and no measured tuning: about 100 hand-set weights; the last two confirmed versions differ by 0.06, i.e. no evidence the later complexity helps.",
  "Crude geometry: line of sight and shot clearance sample a 2 m height raster every ~3 m and treat every structure as a solid column from ground to roof; trees and canopy are ignored; overhangs/bridges block; thin walls can be skipped. Cover and firing-lane decisions inherit these errors.",
  "Navigation on an 8 m lattice needing 4.1 m obstacle clearance cannot see narrow passages, ignores slopes and does not grow with cube size (radius reaches 3.75 m at 10 cubes); A* is capped at 1,800 expansions so long routes are partial; recovery from being stuck relies on jump/jet.",
  "Farm-first target scoring: crates and drones outrank a visible, non-aggressive mech until 10 cubes, and healthier distant mechs are actively avoided early. In practice scoring, where points come from killing house bots, this delays kills.",
  "Conservative survival loop (retreat at 60%, heal to 91%, hold fire while healing) assumes hunters lose track; against a vision-sharing squad the stand-still repair condition (no enemy with line of sight, nearest over 30 m) is easy to violate and the bot may spend long periods fleeing without dealing damage.",
  "Third-party bonus and 'alive <= 5' logic are free-for-all concepts with little or no effect in squad practice mode.",
  "Upgrade ranking ignores whether the weapon is held (laser damage and lightning upgrades rank high without the weapon); gun magazine ranks second overall.",
  "Mortar uses only a low direct arc with approximate drop compensation; no high lob over cover despite being allowed to target without line of sight.",
